locations.note: Nancy goes undercover as assistant to the masked designer Minette, who is receiving threatening letters while she makes a gown for France's First Lady.
Minette's studio is in an old windmill on the hill below the Sacré-Cœur, and its hidden chamber holds the game's last secret.
Statue puzzles in the little park below the Pont Neuf open the way into the tunnels.
Nancy wades through flooded tunnels in a wetsuit to recover the clues that lead back to Noisette Tornade's wartime secret.
